receipts.detail: At sealed HEAD 9bf8bc0df749d1136fe8d19c163ba433d358a0fa the unchanged integration remained red after approximately 483 seconds: node .605 exhausted its fixed join attempts under distributed participant pressure, its self-WebSocket timer was starved, and .606 was never attempted. The same pre-attribution failure at 0d545fec1 ruled transport attribution out as the primary regression.

Real UnifiedRebalancer witnesses located the original formation owner failures: terminal replacement history hid a still-live surplus ledger voter from the canonical replica projection, and the pending-published priority branch rebuilt a full current-placement observation that it immediately discarded. After the later DELETE/cache repair, the next unchanged seven-node run exposed a distinct canonical cache-boundary violation: authoritative catch-up reapplied already-identical rows, minted readiness mutation generations, and woke every publication listener until operational ingress collapsed. The 64-row SystemTableCache witness enters the production catch-up and cache-repair owners and measures zero semantic change directly.

The final CDC/cache authority remains one owner boundary. A 64-row already-aligned authoritative NODES catch-up produces zero listener wakes and zero mutation-generation increase, while a changed SERVICES routing field remains one real mutation. A zero-row durable DELETE reasserts absence through PartitionServiceRowOwner -> control-plane gateway -> CDC -> leader-witnessed read -> SystemTableCache. Point repair uses atomic row-plus-key-generation snapshots and fails closed for revisionless caches. Full-table catch-up captures immutable key revisions before awaiting the owner, preserves concurrent same-key updates, and upgrades concurrent ordinary DELETE tombstones. Complete leader reads advance the cache's existing monotonic authoritative-observation watermark only after valid reconciliation; missing-key writes must prove they follow that leader observation. The gateway now preserves the serving leader's observedAtMs as the causal frontier and separately carries its local pre-read clock as readStartedAtMs, so clock skew cannot fence a causally newer CDC row. Before the later landing-only harness alignment, the formerly failing real preflight passed 48/48 against these source bytes (sha256 a3fd6759afb580f168bbdf0db4f7ecec8755a54ca6cf1ead929ede71ad9caa94). The byte-current full cache/CDC cone passes 68 files with 2833 assertions, the owner-interaction cone passes 1732 assertions, and the broader convergence cone passes 3347 assertions.
